menu.description: Coconut + Velvety Milk = Double Enjoyment Made with IIAC Gold Medal coffee beans, paired with coconut milk beverage and Hokkaido's velvet-flavored thick milk. Experience a delicious and unique milky latte like no other.

menu.description: Fat-Free. Juice content exceeds 1 orange* Enrich your Americano with a zesty orange burst.
